scope: canonical STEP mother wall_reference stations -> tessellated parent surface plus face lineage -> SynLab fragment ancestry -> A12 degrade.wall_intervals

stage_1.name: mother_mesh_station_binding
stage_1.purpose: Bind every finite wall_reference station from the frozen canonical STEP to the tessellated parent surface and same-face triangle lineage.
input: PASS face_semantics tied to STEP SHA
frozen wall_reference v1 tied to STEP SHA
success_conditions: All exact file SHA values independently recomputed and closed through the VF manifest.
Frame is right_handed_z_up; coordinates and lengths are mm; directions are dimensionless.
Canonical B-rep face count, semantic face index, role, classifier and STEP SHA agree.
Every requested station revalidates inside its trimmed B-rep face, not only on the underlying untrimmed surface.
Every station binds to one parent triangle selected only among triangles with the exact source B-rep face index.
Parent mesh station projection error and B-rep-to-facet normal angle satisfy recorded local tolerances.
No distinct-face near tie or parent lineage contradiction exists; full finite station mapping fraction is 1.0.

stage_2.name: parent_triangle_to_fragment_ancestry
stage_2.purpose: Compose fragment/damage result geometry back to the exact parent mesh triangle, then to the canonical STEP B-rep face and wall role.
required_channels: per-corner barycentric coordinates or explicit child-to-parent transform
success_conditions: Each inherited face's corners reconstruct against one exact parent triangle within tolerance; no majority-vote-only ancestry.
Hash namespace, face count and face ordering remain tied to the original parent mesh file/content identity.
Mapping to physical result composes through the clean fragment face/triangle; current face-origin label alone is insufficient.
Near ties across distinct B-rep face IDs or outer/inner roles become UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS, not nearest-selected.
nonclaims: station mapping does not imply wall interval pass
fragment mapping is finite ancestry, not global material coverage

hash_contract.canonical_step_file_sha256: sha256 of exact canonical STEP file bytes
hash_contract.face_semantics_file_sha256: sha256 of exact semantic report bytes, separate from STEP hash
hash_contract.parent_mesh_content_sha256: new canonical hash over schema tag, units, frame, shapes, fixed-endian vertices_mm, faces, and face_source_brep_index arrays
hash_contract.synlab_mesh_hash: optional geometry-only helper hash; record separately because it rounds vertex coordinates to 9 decimals and omits face attributes

stage_1_station_mapping.frozen_station_id: retain v1 station_id as displayed/source ID; also carry full STEP SHA, B-rep face index, wall_role and wall-reference artifact SHA
stage_1_station_mapping.trimmed_uv: re-evaluate sample u,v on canonical B-rep face; require BRepClass_FaceClassifier state IN; ON/OUT is UNKNOWN
stage_1_station_mapping.triangle_search: restrict candidates to face_source_brep_index == source_wall_face_index_zero_based; global nearest is diagnostic only and never a fallback
stage_1_station_mapping.mesh_station_for_ray: barycentric closest point on selected parent triangle; record alongside original STEP point and projection error
stage_1_station_mapping.normal_source: canonical face-oriented outward_from_material normal from face semantics re-evaluated at the bound station; never a fragment/interface normal
stage_1_station_mapping.same_face_tie: allow deterministic minimum triangle index only when all tied triangles have the same B-rep face ID and projection points agree within tie_tolerance_mm
stage_1_station_mapping.different_face_tie: UNKNOWN / AMBIGUOUS_FACE_LINEAGE when a different face has a candidate in the uncertainty band or equal-distance tie

candidate_tolerances.linear_projection_limit_mm: target_linear_deflection_mm + 2*weld_tolerance_mm + cad_numeric_tolerance_mm; also record actual per-station error
candidate_tolerances.normal_angle_rad: min(15 degrees, max(5 degrees, 2*angular_deflection_rad)); must pass actual oriented-normal comparison
candidate_tolerances.tie_tolerance_mm: max(recorded same-face weld/numeric tolerance, documented nearest-distance uncertainty); frozen in binding schema

stage_1_station_mapping.coverage_semantics: 100% means every finite v1 station mapped; it is not wall area coverage

a12_wall_intervals_adapter.call: measure_material_intervals(source_mesh, result_mesh, stations_mm, wall_directions, direction_evidence=..., result_evidence=..., station_ids=...)

directions.trusted: true only after binding hash/lineage/normal validation
directions.provenance: include STEP SHA, wall-reference SHA, binding SHA, parent mesh content SHA, station IDs, B-rep face IDs and roles

a12_wall_intervals_adapter.subset_evidence: trusted only when a verifier has established result material is a subset of the exact source mesh; phase-1 identity case requires source and result composite mesh identities equal
a12_wall_intervals_adapter.precision_gate: derive Open3D float32 merge tolerance; require probe_offset_mm > 8*merge_tolerance_mm and 16*merge_tolerance_mm < min_remaining_wall_mm; if no feasible local offset use UNKNOWN
a12_wall_intervals_adapter.stage_1_baseline: source_mesh=result_mesh=exact parent mesh, stations are projected mesh points, directions are bound B-rep outward material normals
never_promote: split result intervals remain SPLIT_INTERVAL and are never summed

minimal_acceptance.expected: STEP, semantics, parent surface, parent lineage and composite mesh hashes validate independently; all face lineage indices in range; arrays are mm/right-handed-Z-up.

Canonical OCP hollow cylinder outer R=10 mm, inner R=8 mm maps both stations; directions have opposite radial signs; sampled mesh wall interval is about 2 mm within a predeclared bound; global remains UNVERIFIED.
Close inner/outer candidate faces never steal each other's station; same-face restricted projection passes only if locally unique; cross-face tie/corrupt lineage yields UNKNOWN.
ON/OUT UV, trim-edge or incompatible face inventory yields UNKNOWN; no untrimmed-surface or global nearest fallback.
Interface-normal, missing provenance, wrong frame/units or unproven subset returns UNKNOWN; same parent mesh identity permits only explicit identity subset evidence.
Fracture inherited faces compose to parent triangle and B-rep wall face using exact hashes/barycentrics; interfaces and mixed/ambiguous ancestry do not map; reorder/hash mismatch is rejected.
All finite station samples PASS still leaves global minimum and physics UNKNOWN; split material intervals are not combined across air or fragments.

source_interface_facts.vf_parent_triangle_lineage: mesh_shape enumerates canonical imported STEP faces and asset.py writes one face_source_brep_index per emitted triangle
source_interface_facts.synlab_fragment_lineage: SourceTaggedResult has source_tri and barycentric channels; Fragment stores face origin/source triangle/interface fields; current majority face source must not be used alone as proof
source_interface_facts.synlab_damage_mapping: current face-origin mapping returns origin/interface class but not a canonical parent triangle foreign key
source_interface_facts.a12_integration: local wall_intervals helper is not wired into P03 per open_items.md; proposal requires an explicit adapter
